subject.title: feat(sandbox): route plugin-tool untrusted fetch+extract through Docker sandbox

question: Should OpenClaw publish `fetchAndExtractSandboxed` as a permanent plugin SDK capability that reaches the agent sandbox backend, rather than keeping this behavior in an owner plugin?
rationale: The PR adds a new exported SDK subpath and a cross-boundary bridge to live sandbox runtime state; that long-term core/plugin contract cannot be selected safely by automated review.

options.title: Approve the core SDK boundary
options.body: Accept the narrow exported primitive after the owning maintainers confirm its contract, lifecycle, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep the behavior plugin-owned
options.body: Do not merge the public subpath if the consuming plugin can own its fetch-and-extract implementation without a missing generic extension API.

recommendation.title: Approve the core SDK boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow exported primitive after the owning maintainers confirm its contract, lifecycle, and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history identifies the author as the only evidenced contributor to this new surface; current-main area ownership needs direct repository-history inspection.
